cases.context:
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
  {mu pi nu : Measure (State (ι := ι))}
  {gamma : Measure (State (ι := ι) × State (ι := ι))}
definition_context: State is the real Euclidean space indexed by the finite type ι, with its canonical Borel measurable structure. The unqualified measures in the signature have no probability or sigma-finiteness instances.

RNLogRatio.logRatio mu pi is Mathlib's total real log-likelihood-ratio function, the real log of the real value of its selected RN function. The gradient is the totalized real gradient of this particular function. This notation alone does not assert a Radon–Nikodym density representation for arbitrary measures.

SmoothFiniteScoreDomain mu pi means mu is absolutely continuous with respect to pi, that fixed log-ratio is genuinely differentiable mu-almost everywhere, and the squared norm of its gradient is integrable under mu. The guarded information is the real integral of this squared norm against mu.

IsQuadraticOptimalCoupling gamma mu nu means the first and second coordinate pushforwards of gamma are mu and nu, respectively, and the extended nonnegative squared-displacement cost of gamma attains the infimum among such couplings.

wassersteinDistance is the extended nonnegative square root of the quadratic transport cost; its toReal is the total conversion. To interpret it as an actual finite real distance one must first have finite cost.
cases.statement:
example
    (hgamma : DisplacementInterpolation.IsQuadraticOptimalCoupling gamma mu nu)
    (hscore : SmoothFiniteScoreDomain mu pi)
    (hmu : Integrable (fun x : State (ι := ι) => ‖x‖ ^ 2) mu)
    (hnu : Integrable (fun x : State (ι := ι) => ‖x‖ ^ 2) nu) :
    |∫ z, ⟪gradient (RNLogRatio.logRatio mu pi) z.1, z.2 - z.1⟫ ∂gamma| ≤
      Real.sqrt (information mu pi hscore) *
        (WassersteinSpace.wassersteinDistance mu nu).toReal
